items.title: Liverpool throw away another 2-0 lead as Iraola loses first Anfield game
items.description: Liverpool threw away another pre-season lead as Monaco came from behind to win 3-2 in Andoni Iraola's first game in charge at Anfield.

items.title: Arsenal concede 'poor goals' as Dortmund win Emirates Cup
items.description: Arsenal produced more comical defending in pre-season as Borussia Dortmund won 3-2 in north London to win the Emirates Cup.

items.title: Chermiti injured after Rangers reject bid for striker
items.description: Rangers reject an offer for striker Youssef Chermiti, with manager Derek McInnes confirming that it did not meet the Scottish Premiership club's valuation.

items.title: Late heartache for Hull as Huang claims PIF London title
items.description: Charley Hull surrendered the lead with a double-bogey on the 17th as Anna Huang stormed to a two-shot victory at the PIF London Championship at Centurion Club.

items.title: Hogh hits hat-trick as Celtic ease past hapless Kilmarnock
items.description: Record signing Kasper Hogh silenced his early critics with a first-half hat-trick as Celtic swept Kilmarnock aside on the new grass pitch at Rugby Park.

items.title: Everton's McNeil & Palace's Johnson poised for swap
items.description: Everton and Crystal Palace are in talks about a swap deal that would see Toffees' winger Dwight McNeil join the Eagles, and Wales international Brennan Johnson move in the opposite direction.

items.title: Hearts agree £1.7m deal to sell winger Kyziridis
items.description: Heart of Midlothian agree a deal to sell Greece winger Alexandros Kyziridis to a Turkish club for a fee of around £1.7m.

items.title: Brazilian top-flight club wear name of English fan with MND on shirts
items.description: Brazilian top flight club Coritiba wear the name of an English fan from Norwich on their shirts to raise awareness of motor neurone disease.

items.title: 'He can't miss!' | Hogh running rampant with first-half hat-trick
items.description: Hogh runs rampant with first-half hat-trick for Celtic.

items.title: Sunrisers Leeds dominate Welsh Fire to remain in eliminator contention
items.description: Sunrisers Leeds kept themselves in contention for The Hundred eliminator while dumping Welsh Fire out of the women's competition in a one-sided contest at Headingley.
